name: Conspiracy Girls
source:
Conspiracy Girls is a short visual novel about cute and funny girls who around exposing conspiracies, and get into all sorts of trouble doing so!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1540830/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《阴谋女孩》是一部短篇视觉小说，讲述了可爱又有趣的女孩们在揭露阴谋的同时，也遇到了各种各样的麻烦！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1540830/]Steam[/url]]
